mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Expect overcast skies around Badger Ridge Middle School today with temperatures around 57 degrees, feeling like 53. Our air quality index is currently at 55, which places us in a moderate air quality alert.

The City of Verona Public Works Department reminds residents that residential refuse and recycling is contracted through Pellitteri Waste Systems, offering weekly trash pick up and biweekly recycling. Residents can also drop off yard waste at 2959 Range Trail or drop off e-waste for a fee at the Verona Recycling Center on Investment Court.

Looking at local events, you can drop in for Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow brings a full night of trivia across town, including Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's.

In police news, officers made contact with two juveniles on Thursday on Ashton Drive riding prohibited eMotos, which resulted in both parents receiving citations for permitting a minor to drive a motor vehicle.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, featuring Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie as today's flavor of the day. They will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
